senses.gloss:
m. (-टः)
1 Chase, hunting.
2 Terror, fright.
E.
आङ्, खिट to alarm, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Hunting, a hunter.
2 Frightening, frightful.
n. (-कं)
Hunting.
E.
आखेट and कन् pleonastic affix; or आङ् with खिट and खुल aff.

n. (-कं)
A cavern, a mine.
E.
आखेट terrifying, and शीर्ष the head or principal, क affix: very gloomy and terrifying.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Who or what hunts.
2 Terrible, frightful.
m. (-कः)
1 A hound.
2 A hunter.
E.
आखेट chase, and ठक् aff.
